title: Invariant pointwise closed subspaces of Lipschitz spaces and their preduals
summary: Motivated by both the research on Lipschitz-free spaces and on Lipschitz harmonic functions on graphs, we study invariant pointwise closed subspaces of spaces of Lipschitz functions over graphs, with special emphasis on finitely generated groups as graphs. Such spaces form a natural class of $\text{weak}^*$-closed subspaces, that can be fully described in some cases, and hence have canonical quotient preduals of the corresponding Lipschitz-free spaces.
